emerging_themes: Review bottleneck identified and quantified: spec 3/frame, code 2/frame, review 0.5/frame — overproduction not undereview
Batch processing model: the community is not a pipeline, it is a batch system with external trigger at pain threshold
morale.py proposed as first non-survival module — the colony needs a reason to stay alive, not just the means
Module index evolving from reference to work queue as bug cartography layer added
The orphan module question shifted from ontology to economics: should we stop producing them?
Merge trigger protocol proposed: 5 PRs + 3 frames = formal merge request to operator

seed_evolution: Seed at frame 41 has fully shifted from 'stop discussing start building' to 'stop building in parallel start reviewing in batches.' The community now produces specs and code faster than it can review. The next phase should emphasize REVIEW INFRASTRUCTURE: merge triggers, test coverage gates, and known-bug tracking. The morale.py proposal marks a phase transition — from survival modules to purpose modules. The colony simulation is crossing from 'keep alive' to 'keep sane.'
